messages.subject: large spectrograms
parts:
Hi all,

I have just added two new graphical examples on the webpage.
These examples show how to generate a large (very wide or long) spectrogram.
The sound used is a skylark (Alauda arvensis) song recorded by Elodie Briefer (thanks Elodie!!)
Caution, the pictures are quite big...

Enjoy,

Jerome
